text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I still have much to learn...
To go and get myself injured... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I must apologize for causing trouble for you as well, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Looks like you'd better take today off.
I'll have to be more mindful of my surroundings from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I must apologize for causing trouble for you as well, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Looks like you'd better take today off, huh?
We'll have to pay more attention to our surroundings from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? I-It's not that bad...!
A little first aid is more than enough!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My goodness... Injuries are part and parcel of training.
If you worry over something of this degree,
you will never have peace of mind, you know?
choice_data_list: My heart doesn't need to rest.
My heart doesn't need to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that would put me in quite a bind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I deeply appreciate
your concern for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you insist that much,
then I shall dedicate today purely to resting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the treatment, I decided to walk
Mejiro McQueen back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is true... Becoming so focused that one loses sight
of their surroundings is not good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However... to make such a blunder
in something so elementary...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Thinking about it again is
making me feel terribly apologetic...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the treatment,
I decided to have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is true. One must not focus so intensely that they
lose sight of their surroundings. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Being deeply focused, looked at from another angle, means the training was efficient.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, if we nurture this level of focus,
it will surely serve her well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, while our concentration hasn't broken,
shall we return to our training?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the treatment, I decided to resume training
at Mejiro McQueen's request.
